response: THE FRAMING OF A BARN DOOR FOR A NEIGHBORHOOD NEWSLETTER WAS A FAMOUS EVENT. WORKERS TOOK GREAT CARE TO MAKE SURE THE DOOR WOULD LAST FOR GENERATIONS. THEY USED STRONG MATERIALS AND FOLLOWED OLD TROADS TO KEEP THE DOOR LEVEL AND STRAIGHT. THE DOOR WAS PLACED IN THE CENTER OF THE HALLWAY AND THE FRAME WAS CHECKED MANY TIMES. THE NEIGHBORS WERE THRILLED TO SEE THE DOOR FINALLY COMPLETED. IT NOW SUCCEEDED IN ITS PURPOSE AND WOULD BE A SYMBOL OF TRUST AND STABILITY FOR THE COMMUNITY.
